findings: Processed paths, permanent-sorted folders and favorite-folder readers split comma-separated strings without escaping. Paths containing commas cannot roundtrip under that encoding; actual writers remain to inspect.
Previously selected buckets similarly split commas; if IDs are raw folder paths as used in repository methods, delimiter ambiguity applies. No runtime DataStore control performed.

folderSelectionModeFlow catches every upstream exception, emits REMEMBER once and ends that collection rather than recovering the live stream. Theme/locale enum parsing has narrower invalid-value fallback. DataStore I/O recovery policy is inconsistent across these readers.

Remember-processed defaults true; filename hiding defaults false; duplicate-scan keys include scope/include/exclude, similarity level and one-time scan flag. Actual defaults for those later readers still unread.

Settings refer to paths rather than content/physical identity, so processed-history semantics naturally follow path strings; replacement/rename migration behavior requires remaining methods and callers.
